question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India is related to ‘Right to Education'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21 A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Earlier our constitution had 3**95 articles in 22 parts and 8**** schedules at the time of commencement.**
 
• Now the Constitution of India has 448 articles in 25 parts and 12 schedules.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Article 21A declares that the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years.

 
 
• This provision makes only elementary education a Fundamental Right.
 
• It was added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2002.
 
• This is considered a major milestone as the country aims to achieve 'Education for All'.
 
 
 
• From the above, we can conclude that Article 21A of the Indian Constitution is the Right to Education.
